name: Muratpaşa
description: Kaleiçi, the old harbour and Antalya’s central neighbourhoods.
tip: Start with a walking day rather than a driving day.

name: Konyaaltı
description: Antalya’s western city coast, with a long beach promenade.
tip: Pair the waterfront with a city stay.

name: Kepez
description: An inland part of metropolitan Antalya.
tip: Use this as a separate city day, checking local transport first.

name: Aksu
description: Ancient Perge and the resort coast east of the airport.
tip: Keep a morning free for archaeology.

name: Döşemealtı
description: An inland district north of the city.
tip: Plan transport before adding a countryside detour.

name: Serik
description: Belek resort country and the ancient theatre of Aspendos.
tip: Combine a resort base with a dedicated history trip.

name: Manavgat
description: Side’s ancient peninsula and Manavgat’s river landscape.
tip: Split the ruins and river into unhurried outings.

name: Alanya
description: An eastern coastal base with a castle-topped peninsula.
tip: Allow a separate stay instead of rushing from Antalya city.

name: Gazipaşa
tip: Consider it when planning the eastern end of a coastal trip.

name: Kemer
description: Resort towns between the Mediterranean and Taurus foothills.
tip: Mix beach time with one carefully planned outdoor day.

name: Kumluca
description: The district for Olympos, Adrasan and quieter coastal trips.
tip: Leave room for slower travel on local roads.

name: Finike
description: A western coastal base for exploring Lycian heritage.
tip: Choose a small number of sites rather than a long checklist.

name: Demre
description: Myra, Saint Nicholas and the coast around Kekova.
tip: Separate land visits from a weather-dependent boat day.

name: Kaş
description: A western district encompassing Kaş, Kalkan and Patara.
tip: Stay locally to give the western coast the time it deserves.

name: Elmalı
description: An inland highland district behind the coast.
tip: Add it to a countryside route, with seasonal conditions in mind.

name: Korkuteli
description: An inland district on routes north-west from Antalya.
tip: Use a flexible road itinerary and check conditions before departure.

name: Akseki
description: A Taurus Mountains district away from the resort coast.
tip: Give mountain driving its own day.

name: İbradı
description: A highland district known for Ormana and Altınbeşik.
tip: Confirm cave access and road conditions before setting off.

name: Gündoğmuş
description: An inland mountain district north of the eastern coast.
tip: Treat remote routes as planned excursions, not quick detours.
